title: BIG BALL BREAK
oneLiner: Smash the wall with a giant bouncing ball before it gets away!
mechanics: Slide the paddle left and right to keep the oversized ball in play.
Break bricks with the ball to score points.
The huge ball is powerful but leaves little room for mistakes.
Bricks speed up and tougher patterns appear as time passes.

controls.a: Launch the ball or nudge the paddle boost

lose: Lose a life when the ball falls below the paddle; lose the game after all lives are gone.
scoring: Earn points for every brick broken, with bonus points for clearing a row.
